title: Replication package for "Exact Mutation Adequacy for Access-Control Policies Is a Property of Guards, Not of a Language"
description:
The code, data and proofs behind the paper's numbers. It contains the TrustWeave tool and the measurement scripts; the JSON artifacts those scripts wrote, each recording the corpus commit it read; the pre-registered study protocols, whose SHA-256 hashes the artifacts record; a container that pins every external tool (OPA, the Kyverno CLI, Cedar, cvc5) at the version the artifacts record; and the Lean 4 development. The policy corpora and the sampled third-party policy files are not redistributed. They remain under their owners' licences, and manifests identify each by repository, path, commit and SHA-256. REPLICATION.md describes the steps to reproduce the results, and CLAIMS.md maps each table and section of the paper to the artifacts its numbers come from.

This is a frozen copy of commit a5beb63033a3722a4051bd68241f25e010b0bace of https://github.com/MohammadThabetHassan/trustweave, with its history. The only additions are documentation and archive metadata.
